proof_body:
by
  intro R _ e h
  constructor
  · rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, Submodule.mem_sup]
    exact ⟨e, Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self e, 1 - e, Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _, by ring⟩
  · rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.mp hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hx1
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hx2
    have h0 : x = 0 := by
      have hex : e * x = x := by rw [ha, ← mul_assoc, h]
      have hz : e * x = 0 := by
        rw [hb]
        linear_combination (-b) * h
      rw [← hex, hz]
    rw [h0]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (e : R), e * e = e → Ideal.span {e} ⊔ Ideal.span {1 - e} = ⊤ ∧ Ideal.span {e} ⊓ Ideal.span {1 - e} = ⊥
